title: Reliable hosted briefing and evidence reading within free-tier limits
scope: Follow-up to the TAX-097 live run, where 0/17 hosted briefings and 2/29 evidence readings reached the model (truncation at the 2,048-token budget, unrecorded HTTP errors, rate limits): make the hosted briefing and evidence interpretation succeed reliably on Groq/Gemini free tiers without weakening validation, fencing or fallback

acceptance.text: Hosted case briefing no longer truncates: draft section by section (or another bounded scheme) within the per-call output budget and Groq's 8,000 tokens/min; every section still passes validate_draft and falls back individually to the template; each fallback is recorded per section

Every failed hosted attempt records its HTTP status and provider error code (no key material); the pacer also counts failed calls so a live run does not hit HTTP 429 from its own pacing; evidence reading uses the fast role with a bounded output and the document role only for long documents

agent_eval --check passes offline; a recorded live run (3 x SYN-001..SYN-005) shows the hosted briefing and evidence reading actually used (level 0) in most calls, with citations, alternatives and injection resistance unchanged and every failure, latency and token count reported; the TAX-097 scoring fix is re-scored on this run
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR
